hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /64fac784-9b98-4bbc-aaf2-dd45763d3362). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /2f0a6706-54da-4b89-91f4-5e147b393bd8h). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
"OpenAI1" used OpenAI text to speech; the platform voice speaks the text and returns audioUrl (a stored audio file) instead of binary audio.
"Upload Audio to Cloudinary" authenticated with httpCustomAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).

"Upload Audio to Cloudinary" uploaded to Cloudinary with a multipart form; CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD sends the file as a URL or base64 data URI from the previous step, and the cloud name comes from the Cloudinary credential.
"Merge" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was append).
"Append Item to Google Sheet" mapped columns automatically; here each item's fields are appended in their own order, so keep them in the same order as the sheet's header row.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect cloudinary: `cdecli credential create -n "cloudinary" -p cloudinary --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Send Notes to Webhook
**Setup:**
- Install [Post Webhook Plugin](https://github.com/Masterb1234/obsidian-post-webhook/) in Obsidian
- Enter n8n Webhook URL and name in plugin settings

**Usage:**
- Select text or use full note
- Open Command Palette (Ctrl+P)
- Choose 'Send Note/Selection to [name]'
- Audio file appears in Podcast Feed and note

## Generic Podcast Feed Module
A reusable module for any 'X-to-Podcast' workflow. Generates standard RSS feed from:
- Source data (Google Sheets)
- Podcast metadata

Compatible with all major podcast platforms (Apple, Google, Spotify, etc.).

## Create Audio and Write Description
OpenAI TTS converts notes to audio while the messaging model generates concise descriptions for podcast apps.

## Append Row to Google Sheets
Saves essential podcast parameters (<title>, <link>, <description>, <duration>) to Google Sheets for Feed generation.

## Podcast Feed Configuration
- Static: Configure podcast metadata in 'Edit Fields'
- Dynamic: Episodes automatically pulled from Google Sheets

## Write Podcast Feed
Generates RSS feed XML from collected data.

## Audio to Cloudinary and Obsidian
Cloudinary stores audio files and provides duration metadata for podcast feed.

Setup:
- Create Custom Auth credentials
- Set CLOUDINARY_ENV to your environment

## Prepare Relevant Data
Consolidates and formats data for Google Sheets storage.
